item.title: DIA, Omar Camacho, Emjay & More Emerging Latin Artists on Our Radar
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music trends and discover new artists on the rise. Today, we're shining the spotlight on three emerging artists from Latin America, handpicked by the editors at Billboard Latin and Billboard Español. Let's get started!
[Music transition]
Host: First up, we have DIA from Puerto Rico. This talented artist has already made a name for himself in the música urbana space, with a unique sound that blends trapsoul and reggaetón. As a skilled piano player and Latin Grammy nominee, DIA has been making waves since his debut single "ONEMVNARMY" in 2020. His smooth vocals and catchy beats have caught our attention, and we can't wait to see what's next. Check out his song "Llamando De Nuevo" and add it to your playlist.
[Music clip: "Llamando De Nuevo" by DIA]
Host: Next, we're heading to Mexico to introduce you to El de la Tinta. This rising star has taken TikTok by storm with his viral hit "Holanda", featuring Angel Cervantes and Sahir Montoya. With over 500,000 video creations, it's clear that El de la Tinta's music is resonating with a new generation. His unique sound combines acoustic guitars, soulful trumpets, and heartfelt vocals, creating a lush soundscape that will leave you wanting more. Give "Holanda" a listen and experience it for yourself.
[Music clip: "Holanda" by El de la Tinta feat. Angel Cervantes, Sahir Montoya]
Host: Last but not least, we have Emjay, another talented artist from Mexico. As a singer-songwriter, Emjay is part of the new wave of pop artists in Mexico, and we can't wait to see what she has in store for us. With her intriguing voice and style, Emjay is definitely one to watch.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for today's episode. We hope you enjoyed discovering these rising stars from Latin America. Make sure to follow us for more music updates and new artist spotlights. Until next time, keep on listening and stay tuned for more exciting music trends!
